Dataset for:
Modular High-Temperature Geopolymer Thermal Energy Storage: Experimental Validation and 3D Modeling

Description:
This dataset supports the manuscript entitled “Modular High-Temperature Geopolymer Thermal Energy Storage: Experimental Validation and 3D Modeling”.

Files included:

1. Thermocouple Measurements.xlsx
   - Experimental thermocouple temperature measurements from the pilot-scale 3 × 3 modular GeoTES prototype.
   - Includes temperature-time data for thermocouples T1–T4 during two consecutive charging–discharging cycles.
   - Supports the experimental results presented in Figure 6 and Table 1 of the manuscript.

2. 3x3_block_rockwool_24hr_bulk.csv
   - Full transient simulation output for the 3 × 3 modular GeoTES digital model over a 24-hour run.
   - Includes time-resolved temperature data for relevant locations in the modeled assembly.
   - Supports the numerical results shown in Figure 5.

3. 3x3_block_rockwool_24hr_summary.csv
   - Summary of key simulation outputs derived from the 24-hour transient model.
   - Includes condensed numerical values used for analysis and comparison with experimental trends.

(Optional files if included)
4. 3x3_block_rockwool_24hr_summary.json
   - Machine-readable summary of the simulation outputs.

5. 3x3_block_rockwool_24hr_bulk.ndjson
   - Structured machine-readable format of the full simulation output.

Units:
- Temperature: degrees Celsius (°C)
- Time: as recorded in the source files (hours, minutes, or timestamps depending on file format)

Notes:
- Experimental data correspond to two consecutive charging–discharging cycles of the laboratory-scale modular GeoTES prototype.
- Simulation data correspond to the transient 3D heat-conduction model described in the manuscript.
- The dataset is provided to support reproducibility of the figures, reported thermal trends, and comparison between experimental and digital modeling results.
